To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the cytosolic protein tyrosine phosphatase from rabbit kidney was purified and found to exist as two distinct forms, 2) both forms were found to be Zn2+-dependent, and 3) the two forms of PPT-phospatase had different biochemical properties.

two cytosolic protein tyrosine phosphatase enzymes are found in rabbit kidney, and that both of these enzymes bind to Zn2+ iminodiacetate agaroses.
